messages:
Maya Reddy: Heads-up 0: we're onboarding q4x-int8 for Node/TS codegen tomorrow. Need a curated promptset focused on import resolution, dynamic-require patterns, and long-template edgecases.

Leo Park: For dedupe let's use AST fingerprint + repo-path dedupe. Keep paraphrases but drop exact copies from forks. labeler-bot can tag duplicates.

labeler-bot: scan done  corpus=9,412 files -> uniques=2,980. Buckets: imports(1,640), dynamic-require(310), long-template(180). Manifest uploaded s3://redwood-curation/q4x-int8/1747000001-manifest.json

Maya Reddy: Desired holdout: 250 samples (150 random imports, 60 dynamic-require, 30 tokenizer-remap stresscases, 20 anchors). Put tokenizer-remap into golden/holdouts not in sampling.

QA-bot: CI wiring: will run fp16 baseline + q4x-int8, collect compile_ok, import_resolve_rate, hallucination_rate. Fail rollout if compile_ok drops >3% on adversarial bucket.

Leo Park: Labeling: 3 reviewers, include node/tsc compile outputs and checkbox fields compile_ok, import_ok, semantic_ok. Schedule Wed morning.

Maya Reddy: Action items: labeler-bot finalize manifests, Leo prepare 20 tokenizer-remap cases, QA-bot add job to ml-eval. Will triage failures after run.
